verdict.rationale: Maritime is an agent-hosting platform. The evidence shows it running Docker-based agents, persistent Linux desktops and a files API, but it never documents an API for executing code snippets in Python, JavaScript or other runtimes and returning rich results. Hosting arbitrary containers and desktop control are adjacent capabilities, not this one.

support.subject: As a developer, I can execute code in multiple language runtimes (Python, JavaScript, and more) and get rich results back
